about: Folder trust: Grok asks a client that sets `x.ai/folderTrust.interactive` before it reads a project's MCP servers, instructions and other settings. Mako shows a card that names what's skipped; Trust project answers `trust`, and Not now or a dropped request answers `reject`.

request.title: Trust this project in Grok?
request.detail: Grok ignores the MCP servers and instructions in /work/greeting until you trust it. A project's settings can run commands on this Mac, so trust only one you know. Instructions, skills and language servers apply from the next conversation.
